newsitem.title: HONDURAS: HONDURAS SUGAR CROP ENDS AT 5.2 MLN 100-LB BAGS.
newsitem.headline: HONDURAS SUGAR CROP ENDS AT 5.2 MLN 100-LB BAGS.

text.p: Honduras sugar production in 1997 ended at 5.2 million 100-lb bags, 400,000 more than in 1996, the head of National Association of Sugar Growers said Wednesday.
Sergio Salinas said Honduras' eight mills produced 4.8 million bags last year.
"The rise in production is due to improvements in cane yields and a rise in the installed capacities of the mills," Salinas said.
Salinas said 4.2 million bags of the sugar produced in 1997 will be sold internally and the remaining 1 million bags with enter the export market. He gave no details.
In 1998, Honduras will produce a similar amount to this year or slightly less given that winter is late arriving this year, Salinas forecast.
But he added that by 2000 Honduras will be producing 6 million bags of sugar each year.
